text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp starts today—inside 
the transit bus, it's as lively as a 
school trip.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, potpourri in your bag? No wonder it 
smells so nice!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Bags tend to trap odors surprisingly 
easily. I made plenty, so... please take 
one."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, are we featured in that 
magazine too... Huh!?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
C-Chrono-chan is reading a normal 
magazine!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's a travel magazine, right? Does it 
have a tiny little race article in it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just looking into our travel 
destination.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A trip! Where to? When are we going?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Since I was given some time off after the 
camp, I went to watch a race with my 
family...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, it really was a race after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Hokkaido sounds so nice, though! You'd 
earn miles since you're flying, right?! I 
wanna go too!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It's so typical of those two that 
sightseeing and gourmet food didn't even 
come up.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to your guidance 
during the training camp as well.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! Let's make it a fulfilling training 
camp!

Yeah! Let's make this training camp a 
great one!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um, you're really full of spirit, 
aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad Chrono Genesis is back to her 
usual self!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this training camp fruitful so 
she can enjoy her trip with a clear mind!
